desc: Build a small-\(N\) exhaustive BFS enumerator for support transitions and distances; it is a research tool only, not a valid submission solver.
Refute earlier block-partition and selected-source matching characterizations that ignored shared pivot-schedule coupling.
Exhaustively validate the current fixed-distance greedy feasibility algorithm and its binary-searched minimum against BFS; it is false, with a mismatch at \(N=4\).
Derive and prove a compact characterization of the semigroup of shared-pivot maps, including realizability and minimum pivot-word length for a map.

Translate the validated map characterization into an exact reachability/minimum characterization for support masks, accounting for coalescence and target support rather than labeled-particle equality.
Derive an \(O(N)\) or \(O(N\log N)\) minimum-operation algorithm from that characterization.
Implement the proven solver, verify it exhaustively against BFS for small \(N\), and run the supplied sample tests.
